scope: Current-facing summary surfaces only: the repository README, the documentation homepage, package READMEs, package project metadata, and citation/archive metadata. Release notes, upgrade and migration guides, compatibility records, readiness reviews, generated API reference output, and other documentation articles are not scanned, so historical and compatibility evidence is never flagged. Identifiers such as CapabilityTokenId, LiabilityHandshake*, AsiBackboneHandshake* tables, and capability.token-* failure codes contain no word boundary or separator before the legacy word, so they do not match.

terms.name: capability token
terms.reason: Capability grant is the 7.x public vocabulary. Name the token only for the signed capability grant token transport encoding (CapabilityGrantToken).

terms.name: audit residue
terms.reason: Decision receipt replaced audit residue in current prose and public type names in 6.0.

terms.name: handshake
terms.reason: Acknowledgment names the behavior. Handshake is reserved for the multi-step protocol and retained identifiers, which belong in articles rather than summaries.
